what_this_enumerated_over.why_this_block_exists: A re-derivation must state which sources it enumerated over, so a reader can see the SCOPE of the check rather than infer it from the answer. Written after a correction of mine was itself wrong because it re-derived over one file when two existed.

route_2_run.route: PubMed search by registration identifier, "<NCT>"[All Fields], run in batches of 6-8
route_2_run.targets: all 22 rows left NO_PUBLICATION_RESOLVED by route 1

THE_CONTROL_THAT_MAKES_THAT_ZERO_MEANING.why: A search that can only return nothing is not a search. Before the zero was accepted, the same route was run against two registrations KNOWN to be published.
THE_CONTROL_THAT_MAKES_THAT_ZERO_MEANING.includes: 23992557 = ICAP, the primary report of NCT00128453
THE_CONTROL_THAT_MAKES_THAT_ZERO_MEANING.conclusion: THE ROUTE RETURNS POSITIVES. The zero for the 22 is a genuine negative for this route.

route_2_run.AND_A_TRAP_AVOIDED: An 11-term OR query without field tags came back untranslated and returned zero. Re-run with explicit [All Fields] tags in smaller batches it still returned zero -- but the untranslated version would have produced the same number for the wrong reason.

three_states_and_why_they_are_never_summ.NO_PUBLICATION_RESOLVED: nothing found by the routes run. NOT 'unpublished'. Counting this as evidence of no publication is the exact inference this paper argues against.
three_states_and_why_they_are_never_summ.NOT_CHECKED: no route was run against it
